_notes: Hades world build (midground terrain + mid/far kits). Read by Assets/Editor/HdrpWorldMats.cs (Run). Terrain: terrain_midground.glb is placed once under a scene root and gets ONE native HDRP/Lit material built from the 4 PNGs (UV tile 64 m is baked into the GLB UVs, so material tiling stays 1). ORM -> mask map: R metallic (orm.B * metallicScale), G AO (orm.R), B 0, A smoothness (255 - orm.G * roughnessScale), the same conversion HdrpGltfMats uses. Emissive is HDR nits (0.0 = off); start 40, raise only if the cracks vanish at 30 m. If cracks look embossed instead of carved, set normalFlipG true. kitEmissive: absolute _EmissiveColor for glTF-converted materials (Assets/HDRP/Mats, names start with the GLB file name) that have an emissive map; world_mats keeps the repeating brick-crack glow of the mid kit down.
